info.title: Genco Finance API
info.description: Shared installation without accounts. All financial calculations are estimated operating profit before tax.

post.description: Debounced unsaved evaluation at the entered selling price. Market bounds are context; maximumScenario uses marketMax on the same recommended channel.

put.description: Requires current version. Creates a new preset version and leaves saved evaluations untouched.

post.description: Appends a new shared category and saves it as a new preset version. Rejects duplicates case-insensitively.
Always calculates on the server. SKU is optional and unique across archived and active products.

put.description: Requires current version. Changed calculation inputs create a new evaluation revision.

post.description: Requires current product edit version. Explicit recalculation preserves product rate overrides.

JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 5 MB; maximum 5 images. Normalizes to JPEG and produces a thumbnail.

get.description: Use image ID or image ID with -thumb suffix.

post.description: .xlsx up to 10 MB, 5,000 data rows per sheet, 20 sheets, 200 columns, 64 MB uncompressed. Expires in 24 hours.

Zero-based source-column indices. Creates no products; formulas and duplicate SKUs are rejected. Valid rows include the same five-channel analysis as /calculate. Source row numbers include the header.
Select valid source row numbers. Saves the reviewed preview analysis as individual evaluations. Idempotent by preview ID. Worker rechecks SKU uniqueness and checkpoints each committed row.
Explicit IDs or all matching filters. Freezes products and latest saved revisions; never recalculates. Reports expire after 24 hours.
